detail.longDescription: If a PreToolUse hook is how you log or block Claude Code's shell commands, it misses some: commands a skill runs as it loads (!`cmd` in SKILL.md) never fire PreToolUse. v2.1.332, out Nov 24, adds a PreSkillShellCommand hook for them. Update first: older versions run them without calling it. https:// code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks# preskillshellcommand To watch a Claude Code session from your phone, we built https:// shell.online # ClaudeCode # AIAgents # Cybersecurity
